style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, bright noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something huge crosses or fills the frame: the spit, a tag, the bucket, the goat's muzzle or the bell. Lens fully covered seven times
character: a fluffy alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe, buck teeth, mild and puzzled; copper bell on her neck; ears bare until 0.6
cast: the GOAT: grey-brown, huge horns, square yellow pupils, chewing non-stop. HIS EARS ARE BARE — he ate every tag he caught
props: TAGS all different: ORANGE round, size of her head; LIME small square; BLUE long narrow; a spray of TINY WHITE; RED round, twice the orange. Pictograms only, no letters. BUCKET: red plastic on the grass
prop_continuity: tags never vanish on their own — only the goat takes them off; his ears stay bare all clip
environment: a mountain pasture, green grass, blue sky, peaks
lighting: blazing mountain noon, hard sun, crisp shadows

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: mild puzzled female voice, calm, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: lines run together with no breath inside each sentence; one full stop only, 6.7-7.2; voiceless after 8.6, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a wet splat at 0.0, a plastic clack on every tag, the bell at 4.1 and 6.7, a hollow thud in the bucket at 8.6, a bell clang and a snapping strap at 9.6, a soft body thud in the grass at 9.8

timeline.a: silent. She throws her head forward and plasters the lens with a white glob: two frames solid white, then it runs down. Ears bare
the orange tag flies into the lens, blacks out the frame and lands on her left ear by 1.2; from 1.2 she strides at the lens until her head fills the frame
the GOAT's muzzle barges in from the right, half the screen, and snaps his jaw shut on the flying lime tag
silent. He kicks the bucket: it rolls into the lens, fills the frame, trundles off, and the blue tag falls out of it
she shakes her whole body like a wet dog, the tags and the long blue one sweeping twice across the full width of the frame
macro: one eye fills half the screen, the goat's lip pulls the blue tag off her while tiny white tags rain over the top of the frame
silent, the only stop. Both hold their heads at the lens, jaws still; the bell swings hard, blurring edge to edge across the whole frame
she rears up, the whole coloured mass lifting with her from bottom to top of frame, and the big red tag flies into the lens and lands on her right ear
silent. Her head slams down and the white glob flies STRAIGHT INTO THE LENS, splattering the frame, then drains to show it landing in the bucket
silent. The goat takes the whole cluster in his teeth and yanks; both heads come together at the lens
silent. The bell tears off, flies into the lens, fills the frame and rises away — she is lying in the grass, dust going up, HER EARS NOW BARE like his; the goat chews the cluster behind her

must_appear: two animals in frame together, muzzles touching; a tag in the goat's mouth; her spit on the lens and later in the bucket; dust from the fall; her ears BARE in the last frame
negative_prompt: tags or a collar on the goat's ears, any letters, cyrillic or logos, subtitles, watermark, strings joining the tags, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, people, hands, props hovering motionless in mid-air, a second alpaca, slow motion, speed ramp, the alpaca standing still in a wide shot, silence in the tail, accented Russian, drawn-out delivery
camera_moves: wide, macro of her eye at 5.5, wide again at 9.6
